summary: No critical or high defects; five medium/low issues: unquoted agent text fed into orchestrator shell commands, backlog export that overwrites claimed or colliding files, an unlocked claim, a branch name with a slash that crashes export, and a config overflow that crashes the budget command.

findings.summary: The orchestrator is told to paste agent-authored free text (`--overrun '<json>'`, `--detail "<error>"`) straight into a shell command with no quoting or escaping rule.
findings.evidence: ENG-25. SKILL.md Policies, Cost ledger: `--overrun '<json>'`; Failure policy: `issue-add retry <stage> <role> --detail "<error>" ...`. Overrun detail and agent error are role-written; a `'` ends the single-quoted argument; `$(...)` in double-quoted --detail expands. CLI has no file/stdin channel for these values.
findings.fix: Add `--overrun-file`/`--detail-file` or stdin; tell orchestrator to write text to a temp file. At minimum require shlex quoting.

findings.summary: `export` overwrites an existing backlog unconditionally; name `<repo-dir-name>-<branch>.json` collides across same-named repos; a claimed backlog silently returns to `ready`.
findings.evidence: ENG-26. export, claim, export again: status ready, claimed_at None. Second export for /b/app same branch overwrites /a/app backlog. os.replace clobbers; backlog_name uses only Path(repo).name.
findings.fix: Refuse or keep existing file in export (leave claimed untouched); make name collision-proof (hash of absolute repo path).

findings.summary: `claim` read-check-write with no lock; two concurrent claims both succeed.
findings.evidence: ENG-26, ENG-23. read_text, status check, tmp write, os.replace; no lock.

findings.summary: Branch with `/` makes export raise FileNotFoundError after state already written pr-open/aborted.
findings.evidence: ENG-17, ENG-25. backlog_name returns f"{Path(repo).name}-{branch}.json"; ran export with feat/x: FileNotFoundError. cmd_set_status writes/commits before export.
findings.fix: Sanitize branch in backlog_name; wrap export OSError into die(1, ...).

findings.summary: Huge budget value in config.json makes deadline_for raise OverflowError; budget command tracebacks.
findings.evidence: ENG-24, ENG-17. default_s 99999999999999999 -> OverflowError from timedelta. Breaks FR-007 fallback.
findings.fix: Upper bound in resolve (<= 86400 s); larger falls back to default.
